summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new 'Customer Invoice Overview' report (Sales → Dashboard). Backend pytest suite (5 tests) all pass: response schema, chronological months Apr–Sep 2026 with Sep marked current, labels 'Mon YYYY', 24 alphabetically sorted rows, month_totals/grand_total consistency, summary counts, Toopa Ice-creamery = 3576 in May 2026, xlsx export (Content-Type + PK zip magic), and 401 on unauthenticated overview/export. Frontend UI verified end-to-end on the public URL: page renders, table has sticky Customer column with bold names + code/city subline, all six month headers with 'current' badge on Sep 2026, footer totals present, search filters to Toopa, 'Hide customers with no invoices' collapses to 1 row (Toopa Ice-creamery) with grand total ₹3,576, Excel button triggers a download (customer-invoice-overview.xlsx). No React errors; only a benign unrelated 400 on some other resource in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend query filter {'status': {'$in': ['active', None]}} correctly includes accounts without an explicit status; verified 24 accounts returned matching Accounts list.
Month window computed via UTC today; a customer onboarded mid-window is still included with zeros — matches spec ('0 where no invoices / not onboarded').
Frontend uses localStorage 'token' for Bearer; consistent with rest of app.
Grand-total in footer recomputes client-side from filtered rows — behaviour matches spec (footer totals recompute for the filtered set).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded data (Toopa Ice-creamery May-2026 invoice of ₹3,576).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Report endpoint: GET /api/reports/customer-invoice-overview + /export. Route file /app/backend/routes/customer_invoice_overview.py. Page /customer-invoice-overview reachable via Sales module → Dashboard submenu item 'Customer Invoice Overview'. Key data-testids: customer-invoice-overview-page, cio-table, cio-month-<YYYY-MM>, cio-row-<accountId>, cio-name-<accountId>, cio-cell-<accountId>-<YYYY-MM>, cio-total-<accountId>, cio-footer, cio-month-total-<YYYY-MM>, cio-grand-total, cio-search, cio-search-clear, cio-hide-zero, cio-refresh, cio-export-btn, cio-summary, cio-subtitle. In Preview, only Toopa Ice-creamery has invoices (₹3576 in May 2026); 24 total customers.
